events.author: monitoring
events.text: At 10:02 the checkout error rate spiked to 40 percent and roughly 1200 users saw failed checkouts over 18 minutes.

events.author: oncall
events.text: The 09:58 checkout-api v2.4.1 deploy introduced a null pointer in the payment path, so the failures are caused by that release.

events.author: oncall
events.text: Rolled back checkout-api and at 10:20 the error rate returned to baseline.

events.author: eng-lead
events.text: Action item: add a payment path contract test before the next release. Owner: platform-oncall.
